items.title: Did Strong Q2 2026 Results and a US$10 Billion Equity Plan Just Shift Duke Energy's (DUK) Investment Narrative?
items.summary: Duke Energy reported past second-quarter 2026 results with revenue of US$7,592 million and net income of US$1,092 million, both higher than a year earlier, alongside six-month revenue of US$16,770 million and net income of US$2,642 million. items.title: Consolidated Edison Q2 Earnings Top Estimates, Revenues Rise Y/Y
items.summary: ED tops Q2 earnings and revenue estimates as higher electric and gas rate bases lift results, while reaffirming 2026 earnings guidance and investment plans.

items.title: PPL Gears Up to Report Q2 Earnings: Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
items.summary: PPL heads into Q2 earnings with revenue and EPS growth expected, supported by higher power demand and rates, but a premium valuation warrants caution.

items.title: Duke Energy to issue $10B in equity to capture gas generation growth opportunity
items.summary: President and CEO Harry Sideris said the company is deploying more than $1 billion per month to meet “record demand.” Advocates in North Carolina say the utility has exaggerated growth projections to justify its spending plan.

items.title: DUK Q2 Earnings Call Centers on Large-Load Capital Upside
items.summary: Duke Energy links contracted data-center demand to up to $10B in capital upside as new loads begin taking power from late 2027.

items.title: Is Wall Street Bullish or Bearish on Duke Energy Stock?
items.summary: Duke Energy has underperformed the broader market over the past year, but analysts are cautiously optimistic about the stock’s prospects.
